description: Source code for owipcalc, an IP address calculator tool for OpenWrt, including functions for parsing, manipulating, and printing IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR addresses, with command-line operation handling.

methods.name: cidr_push
methods.description: Push a CIDR address onto the stack.

methods.name: cidr_pop
methods.description: Pop a CIDR address from the stack.

methods.name: cidr_clone
methods.description: Clone a CIDR address.

methods.name: cidr_parse4
methods.description: Parse IPv4 CIDR address from string.

methods.name: cidr_add4
methods.description: Add two IPv4 CIDR addresses.

methods.description: Subtract two IPv4 CIDR addresses.

methods.name: cidr_network4
methods.description: Convert IPv4 address to network address.

methods.description: Convert IPv4 address to broadcast address.

methods.name: cidr_contains4

methods.name: cidr_private4

methods.name: cidr_linklocal4

methods.name: cidr_prev4

methods.description: Convert IPv4 address to 6to4 IPv6 prefix.

methods.name: cidr_print4
methods.description: Print IPv4 CIDR address.

methods.description: Parse IPv6 CIDR address from string.
